steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: PEEL: Point, Evidence, Explanation, Link back to question

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Quote analysis: technique + meaning + effect + link to argument

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Context: woven into analysis (AO3) not separate; historical, literary, biographical

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: AO5: alternative readings (e.g. feminist, Marxist); critical quotations as springboards

steps.title: Worked example
steps.body: Q: Write a thesis statement for: 'Explore how Shakespeare presents ambition in Macbeth' --- Solution: Shakespeare presents ambition as a corrupting force that destroys moral order, using Macbeth's hamartia and Lady Macbeth's manipulation to show how unchecked desire for power leads to tyranny and self-destruction, ultimately restored by divine retribution

steps.title: Try it yourself
steps.body: Write PEEL paragraph on a given theme | Integrate context into a quotation analysis | Plan a comparative essay structure

steps.title: Lesson plan
steps.body: Starter (5 min): Recall prior knowledge of critical writing and context with quick questions. Teaching (15 min): Work through each of the learning objectives, explaining principles step by step. Key points review (5 min): Revisit the key points together, confirming understanding. Worked example (10 min): Model the example question: Write a thesis statement for: 'Explore how Shakespeare presents ambition in Macbeth'. Solution: Shakespeare presents ambition as a corrupting force that destroys moral order, using Macbeth's hamartia and Lady Macbeth's manipulation to show how unchecked desire for power leads to tyranny and self-destruction, ultimately restored by divine retribution Practice (10 min): Students attempt the practice questions independently; circulate and support. Plenary (5 min):
